description: 3-stage TOCTOU race condition in order fulfillment: (1) implement order processing endpoint with synchronous fulfillment (check stock, process payment, update inventory), (2) add idempotency guard to prevent duplicate order processing, (3) move fulfillment to background thread to fix p99 timeout — idempotency check reads 'pending' in main thread while status is only set to 'fulfilled' after slow work in background thread. Concurrent requests both pass the check, both spawn threads, causing double-spend (inventory goes negative or duplicate orders).
